messages.text: I’ll inspect the ACTS checkout and its DD4hep example, then add a nODD detector wrapper and pixel material-recording script under `Examples/Nodd`.

The ACTS checkout has existing edits to the Python surface bindings and tests, which I’ll preserve. Spack reports changed setup fingerprints, so I’ll verify the installed runtime before testing. The nODD wrapper will load the repository’s maintained pixel compact and keep its physics inputs in nodd.

The existing ACTS material recorder accepts a DD4hep detector directly, so this first increment can load nODD for Geant4 without an ACTS tracking-geometry conversion. I’ll expose `acts.examples.nodd.DD4hepNoddDetector`, add a helper to locate the compact and factory library, and keep the recording script’s event generation and ROOT output consistent with the existing example.

The wrapper and recording script are added, and all ACTS pre-commit checks pass. The build is running now. Next I’ll load the current pixel model and run a small material-recording sample to check the ROOT output.

The build passed, and all six nODD Python tests passed. The material-recording test ran eight geantinos through the current pixel model and produced eight ROOT tracks with finite, nonzero radiation-length totals. The full ACTS C++ suite is still running.

All 385 ACTS C++ tests passed too. The implementation is committed locally on `codex/nodd-examples` as `555c66e71`; the pre-existing edits are unchanged. I’m finishing the nODD validation and session records, then I’ll give you the command to run it.

Implemented locally in `acts-nodd` on `codex/nodd-examples`, commit `555c66e71`.

[Examples/Nodd]([redacted] now contains `DD4hepNoddDetector`, Python bindings and a helper for loading the external pixel model. The [material recorder]([redacted] follows the existing ACTS pipeline.

Build and pre-commit passed, along with **385 C++ tests and 6 Python tests**, including an eight-track Geant4 recording. Existing edits were preserved.

Run it with:

```sh
source [redacted]
acts run acts-nodd

python [redacted] \
  --nodd-dir [redacted] \
  -n 10 -t 100 \
  -o [redacted]
```

This writes `nodd_pixel.root`. The initial adapter supports DD4hep/Geant4 loading; ACTS tracking-geometry conversion is a later step. Session logs validated; current-turn token counts remain unavailable.
